title_en: A glass of water: kozarec vode
card_en: After a word of quantity, such as kozarec, a glass, or malo, a little, the noun takes the genitive, the of-form: voda becomes vode, sok becomes soka, vino becomes vina.

quick_check.explain_en: After kozarec, a glass, pivo takes the genitive: kozarec piva.

helper_de: German says ein Glas Wasser and leaves Wasser as it is. Slovenian marks the of in the ending: kozarec vode.
helper_en: English needs of: a glass of water. Slovenian has no word for of here; the ending does the job: kozarec vode.
